taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts S. integrifolium, but old Central Texas labels such as S. integrifolium var. asperrimum are not safely counted as current S. integrifolium; Kew now treats var. asperrimum as a synonym of S. asperrimum.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Older Central Texas sources use S. integrifolium var. asperrimum or var. radulum. Current Kew taxonomy separates some of those historical concepts, so they are not being reassigned to S. integrifolium sensu stricto without specimen-level reconciliation.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Current-concept exact county evidence remains unresolved.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not recycle old infraspecific names into current S. integrifolium sensu stricto.

morphology.look_here_first: Wholeleaf rosinweed has broad mostly entire leaves and yellow radiate heads, but Central Texas historical names overlap S. radula and S. asperrimum. Confirm current concept from specimen-quality leaf/stem pubescence and leaf-arrangement characters.
